steps.detail: Alert HHF-016 was triggered when transaction 3611043 ($3,008.76) on card C02502-K2 received an automated risk score of 0.79 without a customer dispute. Investigation confirmed that the in-person purchase took place in region 123, the primary billing region accounting for 59.5% of the card's lifetime activity, and involved product W, which represents 95% of card history. The charge closely followed another in-person product W transaction of $3,025.17 an hour earlier by the same holder, whose profile has no history of fraud. The card has no fraud ring affiliation, and past confirmed fraud cases on this account involved out-of-region card-present transactions rather than home-region activity. The transaction represents legitimate cardholder spending, and the case is cleared.
